_meta.name: Aerie design tokens
_meta.naming: CSS variable = --aerie-<group>-<token>. A token has either value (+unit) or light and dark. Optional reduced = value under reduced motion.
_meta.axes: Two independent axes. Theme (user choice, global default, optionally overridden per Workspace) = how the chrome is rendered: surfaces, tint strength, shadows, materials; group 'theme' below. Workspace colour (per Workspace, one of 8 presets, group 'workspace') = the hue every theme uses in its own way. Theme keys: plain names become --aerie-theme-<token> for the active theme and colour mode only; 'color.x', 'shadow.x', 'size.x' override that token while the theme is active. '_modes' lists the colour modes a theme supports; a theme without 'light' falls back to Clean in light mode.
_meta.workspace-override: Per-Workspace appearance is data, not tokens: the Workspace record in the Tab Model carries { colour: preset, theme: 'default' | theme id, mode: 'default' | 'light' | 'dark' | 'system' }. Effective theme = Workspace theme unless 'default', then the global default theme. Effective mode = Workspace mode ('system' follows the OS) unless 'default', then the global mode. prefers-contrast: more selects High contrast regardless of overrides unless the user chose a theme explicitly.

frame-base.description: Window frame and sidebar base colour, under the workspace tint.

frame-shade.description: The colour of the shade layer over the frame tint. Its opacity is the theme's shade.

frame-glow.description: The colour of the glow at the frame's top corner nearest the sidebar. Its opacity is the theme's glow.

text.description: Primary text. Never changes per workspace.

scrim.description: Backdrop dim behind the command bar.

text-on-accent.description: Text and glyphs on an accent fill.

page-block.description: Placeholder blocks in the fake page.

status-ok.description: Success and "contrast passes" text and chip colour, on popover surfaces.

status-warn.description: Warning text and chip colour, on popover surfaces.

status-danger.description: Error and destructive text, borders and outlines, on popover surfaces. Also .mi.danger and the window-close hover.

danger-fill.description: Fill of a solid destructive button. Text on it is text-on-danger.

grain-max.description: Grain overlay opacity at the slider's 100%. Grain is off in OLED and High contrast.

lg.description: Tab rows and the content card.

family.description: UI font stack. No web fonts.

sidebar-width.description: Default sidebar width, drag-resizable on its inner edge.

pinned-max-rows.description: Rows of the Pinned list that show before it scrolls.

back-button.description: The "Back to pinned page" button of a pinned row.

pencil-button.description: The pencil button after the title of a renamed tab. It resets the name.

inset-comfortable.description: Gap between frame and page card, comfortable.

inset-compact.description: Gap between frame and page card, compact.

rail-tile.description: Icon tile in the collapsed rail.

hot-zone.description: Edge hot zone that peeks the hidden sidebar.

sleep-badge.description: Moon badge on the favicon of a sleeping tab, width and height.

sleep-badge-offset.description: Moon badge on a sleeping tab's favicon: distance of its top-left corner from the favicon's top-left corner, on both axes.

border-hairline-width.description: Width of a hairline border: the rename field's outline. The colour of a hairline is the colour token border-hairline.

hz-strip-height.description: Horizontal tabs, one row: tab strip height (comfortable).

hz-strip-height-compact.description: Horizontal tabs, one row: tab strip height (compact).

hz-strip-height-two-row.description: Horizontal tabs, two rows: tab strip height (comfortable). Default layout.

hz-strip-height-two-row-compact.description: Horizontal tabs, two rows: tab strip height (compact).

hz-toolbar-height.description: Horizontal tabs, two rows: toolbar row height (comfortable).

hz-toolbar-height-compact.description: Horizontal tabs, two rows: toolbar row height (compact).

hz-tab-min.description: Horizontal tab minimum width. Below hz-tab-icon-only it shows the favicon only.

hz-tab-selected-min.description: The selected tab never shrinks below this width.

hz-tab-icon-only.description: Container width at or under which a tab drops its title and close button. Must match the @container rule in horizontal.css (checked by gen_tokens_css.py).

hz-tab-pinned.description: Pinned tab width in the strip.

hz-tile-strip.description: Favorite tile size in the strip (comfortable).

hz-tile-strip-compact.description: Favorite tile size in the strip (compact).

hz-tile-strip-two-row-compact.description: Favorite tile size, two rows, compact.

hz-flare-radius.description: Radius of the concave flares that join the selected tab to the page card.

hz-address-pill.description: Address pill preferred width in the strip or toolbar.

hz-scroll-fade.description: Width of the fade at the edges of a scrolling Today group.

peek-show.description: Hidden sidebar peeks in (spring curve, Zen compact slide is 250ms).

workspace-switch.description: Full-pane Workspace slide (outgoing and incoming panes as a strip), and the swipe spring-back. Reduced: crossfade, no movement.

sheet-enter.description: Folder editor sheet appears (decelerate). Reduced: fade only.

switch.description: Switch thumb and chip state change in the folder editor.

autofile-pulse.description: Folder row highlight after a tab was filed into it.

archive-collapse.description: Tab shrinks and flies toward the Archive button. Reduced: fade only, no movement.

archive-pulse.description: Archive button pulses once after a tab lands. Reduced: colour flash, no scale.

archive-restore.description: Archived row flies back into Today. Reduced: fade only.

tab-open.description: Horizontal tab open: width grows from 0 and the tab scales in.

tab-close.description: Horizontal tab close: the tab slides, fades and its width collapses.

spring.description: Spring settle (stiffness 380, damping 32, mass 1), CSS linear() approximation over motion-spring-duration.

in-out.description: Symmetric ease for folder collapse and reveal.

spring-settle.description: Critically damped spring, no bounce (CSS linear() over the duration it is used with). Used for the Workspace switch.

linear.description: Linear progress. Used where the motion is a timer, such as the Workspace drag ring.

duration.description: Settle time the CSS linear() curve is sampled over.

close-slide.description: Closing row slide toward the outer edge.

toast-rise.description: A toast rises this far while it fades in. It only fades out. Reduced motion: no rise.

swipe-commit.description: Swipe distance that commits a workspace switch.

peek-grace-x.description: Pointer outside the window: peek stays open within this horizontal distance of the sidebar.

sidebar-hide-offset.description: Extra distance past the sidebar width that it slides when hidden or shown (and when peeking), so it is fully off screen at rest.

menu-enter.description: Context menu starting scale: it opens from this scale to 1 while it fades in.

archive-collapse.description: End scale of a tab flying to the Archive button.

archive-pulse.description: Peak scale of the Archive button pulse.

ws-ring-start.description: Start scale of the drag-onto-Workspace ring (shrinks to 1).

cmdbar-start.description: Command bar starting opacity, so it is visible in the first frame.

ws-ring-start.description: Start opacity of the drag-onto-Workspace ring.

peek-delay.description: Hover-in delay: pointer dwell in the edge hot zone before the sidebar peeks.

peek-leave.description: Keep-open after the pointer leaves the sidebar (Zen: 150ms).

peek-outside-max.description: Mockup stand-in for OS cursor tracking: how long a peek stays open after the pointer left the window inside the grace distance.

ws-drag-hover.description: Dragging a tab over a Workspace icon: hover time before the Workspace switches (Zen: 500ms).

autofile-delay.description: Pause between a new tab appearing in Today and it flying into its auto-filing folder, so the move reads as a cause and effect.

toast-action.description: Toast with actions (Undo, Don't file this site) stays long enough to read and click.

dusk-accent.description: Dusk accent: stop 2 with lightness adjusted for 3.2:1 contrast on the frame, saturation capped.

tide-accent.description: Tide accent: stop 2 with lightness adjusted for 3.2:1 contrast on the frame, saturation capped.

moss-accent.description: Moss accent: stop 2 with lightness adjusted for 3.2:1 contrast on the frame, saturation capped.

ember-accent.description: Ember accent: stop 2 with lightness adjusted for 3.2:1 contrast on the frame, saturation capped.

lilac-accent.description: Lilac accent: stop 2 with lightness adjusted for 3.2:1 contrast on the frame, saturation capped.

slate-accent.description: Slate accent: stop 2 with lightness adjusted for 3.2:1 contrast on the frame, saturation capped.

sand-accent.description: Sand accent: stop 2 with lightness adjusted for 3.2:1 contrast on the frame, saturation capped.

mint-accent.description: Mint accent: stop 2 with lightness adjusted for 3.2:1 contrast on the frame, saturation capped.

folder-edge.description: Drag over a folder row: top and bottom this fraction mean before/after; the middle means into the folder (Zen: 20%).

rubber-band.description: Swipe past the first or last Workspace: displacement = x * (1 - |x| / (this * width)) (Zen: 4.5).

swipe-velocity.description: Swipe speed (px per ms) that commits a Workspace switch even below the distance threshold.
